description: This file defines the UpDownImage class, a custom Swing JPanel component used to render visual representations of engine reports, including signal waveforms, revolutions, and timing cues in a vehicle engine analysis or monitoring application.

classes.name: UpDownImage
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component responsible for rendering engine signal data and related annotations in a graphical format, including mouse interaction and real-time updates.

methods.name: setTranslator
methods.description: Sets a custom TimeAxisTranslator for converting time units to screen coordinates.

methods.name: createTranslator
methods.description: Creates a default TimeAxisTranslator based on the EngineReport's timing data.

methods.name: setWaveReport
methods.description: Updates the component with a new EngineReport and optional revolution data, triggering a repaint.

methods.name: setRevolutions
methods.description: Updates the revolution log used for display annotations.

methods.name: setPhysicalPin
methods.description: Sets the physical pin label and updates tooltip information.
